_notes: semgrep_rules files are the detector side of the circularity firewall; they must not contain any catalog anchor (tests/test_corpus.py checks configs/detector_patterns.txt)
registry_snapshot.json and advisories.json are taken at the freeze date and pinned by digest in the freeze record

python is used only with a repository config that has no env block; configs/click.json has one, so evidence.run and evidence.baseline run each candidate in its base commit's environment (corpus/envs.py), with the pinned pytest, coverage, bandit, griffe, import-linter and atheris. challenger.python, when set, gives the challenger's calls another interpreter; it is unset here, so they run in the same environment, which differs from the authoring agent's configuration as required. Two tools run outside that environment, pinned in the repository config's env.host_tools: hypothesis generates and shrinks ch.property's inputs in the orchestrator (requirements-dev.txt pins it; the environment's copy is not the one that searches), and semgrep runs from a venv of its own (corpus.envs.ensure_tool). Under a freeze record evidence.run refuses either at another version, and the F2 and ch.property records carry the version they ran with
challenger.factories maps an annotation's type name to an expression evaluated inside the executor of each tree; it covers parameters that are not JSON-able and is part of the frozen configuration

challenger.budget_ci_equiv (the search budget per invocation) and challenger.fuzz_time_per_target_ci_equiv are in standard-CI equivalents, not seconds: evidence.run converts them with this repository's ci_baseline (seconds = CI-equivalents x cpu_s_median), so a faster machine buys the same search per CI-equivalent, and every challenger record carries budget_ci_equiv, ci_baseline_cpu_s and the derived budget_s. call_timeout stays in seconds: a safety timeout, not a budget. 59.73 and 9.96 are the former 120 s and 20 s converted with the flask dev baseline (2.009 s, corpus/flask-dev/ci_baseline.json); Task B2 re-derives them from the real baselines.
